messages:
Anna K: opened a small PR to consolidate Dedicated provisioning phrasing and add concrete examples (YAML + SDK). PR: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/879
Mike T: quick read. main issue: autoscale section confuses cooldown vs preemption. please make it explicit.
Sasha R: suggest adding a minimal YAML snippet showing scalePolicy fields and cooldown units. e.g. `cooldown_sec: 120` and `preemption_behavior: best_effort`.
DevRel Sam: also want a short Python SDK example next to it so users can copy-paste.
Leo P: SDK API recently changed call should be `.update_scale_policy(...)` and include tenant labels to illustrate isolation: `tenant_labels: ["team:search"]`.
Marie O: legal flagged the SLA text ",best effort" as underspecified. propose explicit line: "SLA: 99.95% uptime for reserved capacity. Preemption only for urgent maintenance with 24h notice unless emergency." Need legal signoff.
ops-oncall: ops note: clarify that `best_effort` preemption means immediate eviction is possible; document automatic routing fallback to compatible model variant and quota enforcement window (15m). Many users expect instant fallback; it's actually subject to routing/backfill policies.
docs-bot: failing link: provisioning anchor `#tenant-labels` returns 404.
Anna K: plan: update PR with Sasha's YAML, corrected SDK snippet (Leo), explicit SLA wording (Marie), ops fallback note, and a short compatibility note for legacy scale schema v1: rename `cooldown` -> `cooldown_sec` and drop `batch_target`.
Mike T: add a one-line migration example for CLI and Terraform too.
DevRel Sam: will draft a tiny sample app showing tenant-labels + fallback behavior tomorrow (ticket TG-331) and paste into the PR.
Leo P: after edits we should squash and request final legal review, then merge.
Marie O: will queue legal review once PR updated.
Anna K: ETA EOD edits, will ping when CI is green. :thumbsup:
